errors.text_span: стойностите са означени със стойности от 0 до 100 с интервали от 10
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis in the chart does not have any tick marks or numerical labels showing a scale from 0 to 100 with intervals of 10. The description invents this feature.

errors.text_span: всеки стълб е изобразен в едноцветна синя тънка линия
errors.evidence: The chart uses solid, filled, rectangular blue bars to represent the data, not 'thin lines' as stated in the description. This is a fundamental mischaracterization of the visual elements.
The phrase 'measured in percent' is redundant when used immediately after 'percentage values'. The phrasing is unnecessarily repetitive.
